notes.title: New Title Screen and Lives
notes.notes: I have added a brand new title screen graphic and also added players lives so that every time you run our of energy you lose a life, so that players now have a chance to play longer

notes.title: Now avalable for Mac OS users
notes.notes: I've built a version of the game for Mac OS users.  I hope you all enjoy my game :)

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
So now when you start a stage the ball will not move until you press a button so now you will have more control of the ball at the start of each stage.

Added a level select so you no longer need a password.  for every 5 levels you complete will unlock a stage if you get a game over so you wont have to start from level 1, but your score will be reset

notes.title: New Launcher
notes.notes: A launcher for the game has been created and added

notes.title: Ball AI improvment plus other fixes
notes.notes:
After some hard work I've been able to improve the balls AI so its less random on its direction when bouncing off of things and adjusted the direction it goes when bouncing off the player.  With the improvement of the balls AI the games difficulty has be set to a more nicer setting then before

Added global sounds to the game.

Still working on adding power ups

notes.title: New game Icon and Title Screen image
notes.notes: Nothing major just changes to the game icon image and title screen

notes.title: New game in the works!
notes.notes: A new game is in the works here called "Mèric's Challenge" its going to be another retro throw back to an old windows game.  it will have mazes, puzzles, and challenges.  More to come soon

notes.title: We did it
notes.notes: Its Official! We are live and ready to play.   Thank you to all the beta testers!

notes.title: Bug Fix 9/19
notes.notes: Fixed the bug when you click on the high score button on the main menu it takes you to view high scores but also asks for you to input you name when you have no score

notes.title: Achievments!
notes.notes: You can now unlock achievements whilst you play

notes.title: DEMO TIME!!!
notes.notes: A demo has been made available for download on the steam page enjoy!

notes.title: Release!!!
notes.notes: The game is finished!  now we just wait for it to be approved and then you all can get the game!
